overview: Delicious Bites is a clean, mobile-first recipe website featuring a searchable catalog of recipes with category and dietary filters, detailed recipe pages with star ratings and comments, a food blog, social sharing, and a contact/recipe submission form.
features: Searchable recipe catalog with 5 sample recipes
Category, dietary, difficulty, and prep time filters
Recipe detail pages with ingredients, instructions, and hero images
Star ratings (1-5) and user comments on recipes
Contact and recipe submission forms with validation
Mobile-first responsive design with bold visuals
